content.short: Nexabit AI is an L3 infrastructure that aggregates institutional data for crypto market trend analysis.
content.description: Nexabit AI is a cutting-edge Layer 3 (L3) AI infrastructure project operating within the TON ecosystem. It specializes in aggregating and analyzing vast amounts of trading data from institutional players and 'whales' to identify emerging market trends and sentiment. Nexabit AI provides users with a Telegram-based mini-app where they can access these insights and farm $NEXAI tokens through various engagement activities. By democratizing access to high-level market intelligence, Nexabit AI empowers individual TON users to make more informed decisions in the decentralized financial markets.
content.meta: Access institutional-level market data with Nexabit AI on TON. Discover trends on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
